restaurant.name: Amol Veg Resto
restaurant.description:
Fresh Ingredients • Authentic Taste
Family Friendly

dishes.name: Crispy Chilli Paneer
dishes.description: Crispy batter-fried fresh cottage cheese cubes tossed with bell peppers, spring onions, and a vibrant garlic-chilli glaze.

dishes.name: Veg Manchurian Dry
dishes.description: Golden fried minced vegetable dumplings tossed in an aromatic dark soya, ginger, and scallion reduction.

dishes.name: Paneer Tikka Angara
dishes.description: Charcoal-grilled cottage cheese cubes marinated in hung spiced curd, mustard oil, and freshly roasted cumin.

dishes.name: Classic French Fries
dishes.description: Golden hand-cut potato fries served sizzling hot, sprinkled with rock salt and chef secret herb seasoning.

dishes.name: Loaded Cheese Fries
dishes.description: Piping hot crispy French fries drenched in rich velvety melted cheese sauce, topped with jalapeño flakes.

dishes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
dishes.description: Velvety cottage cheese cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato and cashew nut gravy, finished with fresh cream & kasuri methi.

dishes.name: Solapuri Shev Bhaji
dishes.description: Authentic Solapuri specialty with a fiery, aromatic kala masala coconut gravy topped with crisp ratlami shev.

dishes.name: Dal Tadka & Jeera Rice
dishes.description: Slow-simmered yellow lentils tempered in pure cow ghee with cumin, garlic, and dried red chilies, paired with fragrant basmati jeera rice.

dishes.name: Farmhouse Pizza
dishes.description: Stone-baked thin crust pizza topped with crisp bell peppers, sweet corn, red onions, mushrooms, and 100% mozzarella cheese.

dishes.name: Margherita Pizza
dishes.description: Golden crust topped with rich Italian san marzano tomato reduction, fragrant basil, and generous mozzarella cheese.

dishes.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
dishes.description: Wok-tossed noodles with garden julienne vegetables, spring onions, and light aromatic soya seasoning.

dishes.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
dishes.description: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice stir-fried in a hot wok with fresh vegetables and zesty homemade Sichuan paste.

dishes.name: Butter Naan & Roti Basket
dishes.description: Traditional clay-oven tandoori breads baked fresh to order and lavishly brushed with clarified butter.

dishes.name: Veg Grill Sandwich
dishes.description: Golden grilled bread filled with crisp cucumbers, tomatoes, bell peppers, mint chutney, and gentle chaat masala.

dishes.name: Veg Cheese Sandwich
dishes.description: Layered fresh vegetables and gooey melted cheese toasted to golden perfection in pure butter.

dishes.name: Club Cheese Sandwich
dishes.description: Hearty three-layered toasted club sandwich with garden vegetables, double cheese slices, and house herbs.

dishes.name: Paneer Crunch Burger
dishes.description: Crumb-fried crispy cottage cheese patty served with crisp iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, and creamy tandoori mayo in a toasted bun.

dishes.name: Classic Cold Coffee
dishes.description: Slow-brewed rich espresso blended with chilled milk and topped with creamy coffee froth.

dishes.name: Chocolate Milkshake
dishes.description: Decadent chocolate milkshake made with real cocoa, chocolate syrup drizzle, and a scoop of rich dairy ice cream.

dishes.name: Solapuri Masala Chaas
dishes.description: Traditional curd churned with roasted cumin, rock salt, ginger, and fresh mint leaves. The perfect cooling digestive.

dishes.name: Chocolate Brownie with Ice Cream
dishes.description: Warm cocoa walnut brownie crowned with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream and hot chocolate fudge.

dishes.name: Gulab Jamun with Rabdi
dishes.description: Golden fried mawa dumplings soaked in cardamom sugar syrup, paired with thick chilled saffron rabdi.
